title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: monitor agents (Worldwide)
summary: Hold: the briefing says agent-monitoring licensing has not been published, but Microsoft's service description names Microsoft 365 E7 and Agent365 for Purview capabilities covering Foundry agents and Entra-connected AI apps. The roadmap facts, default policy behavior, role assignments and automation are supported; the policy path and audit-default wording need small clarifications.
